purpose: One fixed trivial A/B replay to measure where OpenCode latency is spent; not a semantic plan test.

environment.network: unshare --net with loopback; external route unavailable
environment.response_schema: Single object with required message enum [ready], additionalProperties false.

result.interpretation: The two recorded prompt evaluations total 29.31662 seconds and output evaluations total 0.88391 seconds. They account for most, but not all, of the 32.86-second post-ready interval. The trace does not establish the purpose of the first model request or attribute it to a specific OpenCode component/plugin.

network_trace.meaning: Observed local DNS lookup attempts; this does not imply that an external connection succeeded or that no network syscalls occurred.

stderr_observation: OpenCode reported a one-time database migration and its completion. The trace does not establish that migration caused the measured latency.
